characteristic_organ_involvement: bone (osteolytic lesions  skull, femur, ribs classical)

biomarkers.name: BRAF V600E
biomarkers.clinical_use: Vemurafenib and dabrafenib are highly active, particularly in relapsed/refractory or multisystem disease. BRAF V600E cell-free DNA can be used for disease monitoring in some settings

biomarkers.name: MAP2K1 (MEK1) mutations
biomarkers.clinical_use: Typically mutually exclusive with BRAF V600E; MEK inhibitors (for example trametinib, cobimetinib) are active

biomarkers.name: Other MAPK pathway mutations and fusions (for example ARAF, MAP3K1, NRAS, KRAS, ERBB3, BRAF fusions)
biomarkers.clinical_use: LCH shows near-universal MAPK-ERK pathway activation; MEK inhibitor therapy is active in non-BRAF V600E disease

biomarkers.name: CD1a, S100, langerin (CD207)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Diagnostic hallmark  langerin is most specific

biomarkers.name: Birbeck granules on electron microscopy
biomarkers.clinical_use: Now largely replaced by langerin IHC

biomarkers.name: Risk-organ involvement (liver, spleen, BM)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Defines high-risk multi-system LCH (LCH-RO+); worse prognosis; requires intensive therapy

biomarkers.name: CNS involvement / neurodegenerative LCH
biomarkers.clinical_use: Often shows cerebellar and brainstem T2 hyperintensity on MRI; associated with chronic disease activity. BRAF/MEK inhibitors are active in some cases

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Aggregates of Langerhans cells (grooved reniform 'coffee-bean' nuclei) with abundant pale cytoplasm, admixed with eosinophils, lymphocytes, and multinucleated giant cells
variants: multi-system with risk-organ involvement (LCH-RO+, worse prognosis)
histomorphological_subtype.grading: Not graded; risk-organ involvement drives management

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: Mixed inflammatory infiltrate with eosinophil predominance surrounding Langerhans cell aggregates; MAPK pathway activation is near-universal (BRAF V600E or other MAPK alterations)
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Aggregates of grooved Langerhans cells with abundant pale cytoplasm; eosinophilic granuloma-like appearance; Birbeck granules on EM (historical)

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Langerhans cells or, more likely, their myeloid dendritic cell precursors (not epidermal Langerhans cells specifically)
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Langerhans cell differentiation with grooved reniform 'coffee-bean' nuclei, abundant pale cytoplasm; CD1a+, CD207/Langerin+, S100+; Birbeck granules on EM (historical marker)
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: MAPK pathway activation is near-universal  BRAF V600E (~50-60%), with other MAPK pathway alterations in many of the remaining cases; represents myeloid-derived histiocytic proliferation with dendritic cell features; multi-system with risk-organ involvement (LCH-RO+) has worse prognosis and may reflect earlier developmental origin
